snippet.title: The Bleakest Keep | Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo on Steam TODAY!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3718130/The_Bleakest_Keep_Demo/
Twitter/X: https://x.com/CacheOfBones

The Bleakest Keep is a challenging action horror roguelike. Survive the horrors of the Keep, upgrade your gear, and earn ranks as you ascend the tower and save the world!

This demo is part of the Steam Zombies vs Vampires Fest as well as the June 2025 Steam Next Fest! This demo contains the first 2 of 4 levels from The Bleakest Keep. I hope you enjoy the demo! Please remember to leave a review for the demo on Steam and to wishlist The Bleakest Keep!
